name: By Your Love
source:
Despite a promising start, Auros Loxias could never unlock his full potential – until Shale Selyne came along. Leaving behind all he knew, he followed Shale into a demanding new life on a remote island. When Shale is hurt and help is far away, Auros must battle his own doubts to save them both. Will love be enough?

[From [url=https://straybats.itch.io/by-your-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尽管有一个充满希望的开始，奥罗斯·洛希亚斯永远无法释放他的全部潜力——直到谢尔·塞林出现。他抛开了自己所知道的一切，跟随谢尔在一个偏远的岛屿上开始了艰苦的新生活。当谢尔受伤且救援遥遥无期时，奥罗斯必须与自己的疑虑作斗争，以拯救他们俩。爱就足够了吗？

[来自[url=https://straybats.itch.io/by-your-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
